_comment: Measured layout, not derived. This file is evidence; everything else in data/ is model output. Captured by reading the live Konsole rather than estimating off an image - see docs/readability-geometry.md, 'Measuring a live layout'.

method.cell_grid: qdbus6 org.kde.konsole-<pid> /Sessions/<n> org.kde.konsole.Session.processId | ps -o tty= -p <pid> | stty -F /dev/pts/<n> size
method.pixel_bounds: per-column uniformity scan of the fullscreen capture
method.screenshot: spectacle -b -n -f -o <path>  (works under Wayland; xdotool/xwininfo do not - Konsole is a native Wayland client and never appears in the X11 window stack)

layout: 1x6 (six panes side by side, one row)

model_validation._comment: Does geometry.py, run at this panel and this viewing distance, predict what was actually measured? This is the first check of the model against a real layout.

rows._units: The model's row budget counts PANE_CHROME's title row, so 40 = 39 content rows + 1 title strip.

model_validation.verdict: Model reproduces the measured layout: columns within 0.6% (171 predicted vs 169.9 accounted for), rows exact (40 vs 40) once the pane title strip is counted on both sides. This is the first end-to-end check of the geometry model against a real layout, and it passes.
